<title level="1" pfs="">[Simple Harrowkin](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2579)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

The simplest harrowkin resemble creatures with vague features made of patchwork cloth and painted canvas

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Construct](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4)): DC 21

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 19

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 16
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 4">[Simple Harrowkin](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2579)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="N" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Small" />
<trait label="Construct" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=35" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #192: Worst of All Possible Worlds](/Sources.aspx?ID=203) pg. 82

**Perception** +10; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12)

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +12, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +9, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +11, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +12

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +3

**Dex** +4

**Con** +1

**Int** +0

**Wis** +0

**Cha** +3
</row>

**Harrowkin Suit** any

**Items**
_harrow cards_ (53^ function as [darts](/Weapons.aspx?ID=68)), [Shortsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=43)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 20 

**Fort** +11 

**Ref** +14 

**Will** +8 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 60

</row>

**Immunities**
[death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) effects, [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46), [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9), [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=10), [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15), [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89), [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=110), [necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117), [nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188) attacks, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34), [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
shortsword +12 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [versatile P](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 1d6+5 slashing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
fist +12 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)),
**Damage** 1d4+5 bludgeoning plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=18)

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
_harrow card_ +12 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [range increment 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [Thrown](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)),
**Damage** 1d4+3 piercing

**Shuffle the Deck** <actions string="Two Actions" />  

**[Sneak Attack](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=34)**   The harrowkin deals 1d6 extra precision damage to [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16) creatures.

</column>
